annotations.title: Make a change from a transformation level

description: Creates a Change from one level of a priority's transformations, with its step effects and the priority it serves, and starts drafting in Workbench up to three flows for what the level says to build (`builds`, each `drafting` until ready). Only a level that fits, once per level. May return `needs_confirmation`.

approvalId.description: Approval id from a prior needs_confirmation envelope.

workspace.description: Workspace slug. Ignored for workspace API keys.
